summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K as a routine announcement of an upcoming board meeting scheduled for August 27, 2026, to approve and publish its unaudited Q2 and H1 2026 financial results, with details for an earnings conference call. The filing includes a safe harbor statement and notes the weighted voting rights structure of the company. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is referenced. The filing is purely procedural in nature, providing notice of a regular financial reporting event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisory roles are mentioned, and there is no risk-arbitrage angle. This is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer.
